loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: Planning and implementation must start from accepted build and updated KB, not chat memory.

requirements.text: CodeWiki must maintain source-layout truth as an explicit intended/current/delta map, not prose-only tribal knowledge.
Main CodeWiki concepts should migrate toward root-level source ownership under src/<concept>/** while preserving adapters/ui as exposure layers and preserving public behavior.
Maintainers should be able to review intended file structure, actual file structure, drift, and approved migration deltas before agents reshape source layout.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Approved rows are mapped to canonical knowledge and diagram sources.

agent_assessment: Accepted semantic decision updates KB only. Source migration and audit/UI behavior remain future planning/implementation work. Risk is medium-high for root concept migration, so executable work must be staged with compatibility barrels and full test evidence.
summary: Accept concept-root source ownership direction, canonical file-structure diagram, drift lens, and human structure review surface

diff_table.current_state: Target package architecture is layer-first: src/domain/<concept> owns pure concepts, src/application/<workflow> owns use cases/local services/tools, src/adapters/** exposes host surfaces, and src/ui/** owns browser UI. Session, state, roadmap, build, validation, and related concepts are intentionally split between domain and application paths.
diff_table.desired_state: Evaluate and, if approved, move toward concept-root ownership under src/<concept>/** for major CodeWiki concepts such as session, state, roadmap, build, validation, audit, project, and agency, while keeping adapters/ui as exposure layers. Each concept root would own its domain model plus application/use-case code for that concept, instead of splitting the concept across src/domain and src/application.
diff_table.rationale: User wants full human-driven development and easier project navigation: one concept should be findable in one top-level source area instead of mentally joining domain and application files.
diff_table.risk: medium-high: broad source migration can disturb imports, package exports, public tool behavior, and recent TASK-008 compatibility guarantees.
alternatives: Keep layer-first architecture and add better maps/search only.
Use hybrid feature folders under src/features/** while keeping existing domain/application internals.
Only move application files next to domain files for concepts with high churn.

diff_table.current_state: System diagrams exist for context, component, key flow, data model, and state lifecycle. File structure is documented as Markdown text in .codewiki/kb/system/file-structure.md, but there is no dedicated canonical raw-data diagram for intended repository/source tree ownership.
diff_table.desired_state: Add a canonical file-structure/ownership diagram raw-data file under .codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/**, sourced from file-structure.md, that represents intended source roots, CodeWiki dogfood paths, generated/runtime artifacts, skill assets, tests, and publication proof boundaries.
diff_table.rationale: User wants to always know intended file structure and inspect it visually alongside the system model.
diff_table.risk: medium: diagram family expansion must remain canonical YAML and avoid duplicating long prose from file-structure.md.
alternatives: Extend component-map.yaml with path ownership nodes only.
Keep Markdown tree only and improve doc anchors.
Generate diagram from file-structure.md instead of adding a separate canonical YAML source.

diff_table.current_state: Current audits pass file-structure checks and diagram-ref checks, but intended-vs-current file structure drift is not a first-class source-tree lens with explicit delta categories tied to a canonical file-structure diagram.
diff_table.desired_state: Add a deterministic drift/delta lens that compares the intended file-structure map to the current repository tree and reports missing paths, unexpected paths, ownership mismatches, deprecated paths, generated/runtime artifacts in source areas, and migration deltas.
diff_table.rationale: User wants intended structure, current structure, drift, and delta mapped continuously rather than inferred from prose plus ad hoc audits.
diff_table.risk: medium: requires designing canonical map schema and audit behavior without creating noisy false positives.
alternatives: Add checks only to existing file-structure audit without new graph lens.
Use CodeWiki UI to render current tree with no audit enforcement.
Run manual audits until source layout stabilizes.

diff_table.current_state: CodeWiki already separates user intent, compilers, validation, audits, graph, and UI, but architecture docs emphasize agent/compiler loops as much as human navigation. File-structure review is mostly through docs/audits rather than a primary human decision surface.
diff_table.desired_state: Make human-driven structure control explicit: docs and UI should present intended structure, actual structure, drift, and approved migration delta as a human-owned decision surface before agents reshape source layout.
diff_table.rationale: This keeps broad architecture moves human-approved and visible, not hidden in implementation tasks or agent-only graph state.
diff_table.risk: medium: product/system language must avoid promising a full new product mode before scope is planned.
alternatives: Treat this only as system architecture tooling, no product/user-facing language change.
Document as maintainer workflow only, no UI work yet.
Defer until after root-concept migration decision.
